jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

Are you passionate about GxP systems and digital transformation? And would you like to take ownership of an essential part of the IT and compliance strategy in an innovative pharma company?

If yes, Pharmacosmos is looking for a GxP Cloud Engineer to join the Global IT team.

Pharmacosmos is a global pharmaceutical company with headquarters in Holbæk, Denmark and subsidiaries in the USA, United Kingdom, Germany, and China. Fueled by rapid growth and supported by over 700 employees, we continue to embrace an entrepreneurial mindset, forging global partnerships to tackle pressing health challenges and improve patient outcomes worldwide. We have a collaborative and people-centric company culture rooted in our Danish heritage and built on quality, trust, and innovation.

About the department

Our Global IT department consists of 13 dedicated professionals, with 10 based at the headquarters in Holbæk. The department is structured into four focus areas: Helpdesk, Security, Application & Operation, and Strategic Projects. This role will join the Application & Operation team and serve as the primary internal expert on GxP-governed enterprise systems.

Global IT is on an exciting journey of modernization, transitioning from a traditional support function to a strategic enabler of digitalization, compliance, and operational excellence. You will work closely with colleagues across QA, Regulatory Affairs, laboratories, and IT.

About the job

We are now strengthening our internal ownership of GxP-governed IT systems – such as LIMS, TMF, and electronic document management systems – and digitalizing the way we work across QA, regulatory, and laboratory processes.

As GxP Cloud Engineer, you will take operational and strategic responsibility for these systems, ensuring they meet validation, documentation, and compliance requirements (e.g., GAMP5, FDA 21 CFR Part 11). You will also contribute to designing and implementing new systems as part of 8–10 major digitalization initiatives planned over the coming years.

This is a highly independent and impactful role with the opportunity to shape how Pharmacosmos governs and develops critical enterprise systems in a regulated environment.

The position reports to the Senior Director, Head of Global IT.

You key responsibilities will include:

• 
Operational ownership of existing GxP IT systems.

• 
System design and architecture for new digital solutions.

• 
Driving digitalization initiatives across QA, Regulatory, and Labs.

• 
Ensuring validation, documentation, and compliance (GAMP5, Part 11).

• 
Collaborating with stakeholders and external vendors.

• 
Defining and optimizing governance and processes.

• 
Acting as subject matter expert and advisor on IT/GxP matters.

About you

To thrive in this role, you bring:

• 
3+ years of experience with GxP IT systems (5+ years preferred).

• 
Experience with systems such as LIMS, TMF, or electronic document management.

• 
Knowledge of validation frameworks (e.g., GAMP5, Part 11).

• 
Understanding of documentation, SOPs, and risk assessments.

• 
Experience with cloud solutions is a plus, but GxP expertise is essential.

• 
A proactive and structured mindset with the ability to work independently.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic and quality-focused environment and are motivated by making a real impact across business-critical systems and processes.

Pharmacosmos offers

• 
A key role in a growing pharma company with high ambitions and strong values.

• 
An opportunity to shape how GxP systems are governed and developed.

• 
A collaborative and flexible work culture based in Holbæk.

• 
Competitive salary package incl. health insurance, lunch scheme.

• 
A global organization with an entrepreneurial and people-focused spirit.

Additional information

Your application and CV (in English) should be submitted using the link above. This recruitment is supported by Capax Recruitment. Please contact Line Kejser at lke@capax.dk or any questions about the recruitment.

**

About Pharmacosmos**

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on their foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, they develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, the team is made up of more than 700 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, the USA, and China. Learn more about Pharmacosmos at www.pharmacosmos.com.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager for Urban Development Projects
jobs.description:
Novafos is seeking a Project Manager for urban development projects – managing stormwater and wastewater solutions in new urban areas

At Novafos, we are everyday heroes in water management – delivering clean drinking water to taps, managing rainwater in urban areas, and discharging treated wastewater into the sea. We are approximately 400 dedicated employees working to ensure that society and the environment can thrive in harmony.

We are now looking for a coordinating Project Manager who will be responsible for ensuring water management solutions in new urban developments, enabling Novafos to continue its important work of creating sustainable, green solutions for future generations.

A role defined by urban development, climate focus, and cross-disciplinary collaboration

You will become part of an urban development team working with a shared planning approach to urban development at Novafos. The Urban Development team within our Planning Department works closely with colleagues from our Project Department, who are responsible for construction and infrastructure projects. Together, we support and enable urban development across our nine owner municipalities.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Acting as Project Manager for urban development projects in close collaboration with the relevant municipality and property developers

• Collaborating with and supporting colleagues working with urban development in both the planning and construction phases

• Contributing to strong cross-functional collaboration between planning and execution in urban development and site preparation projects

A strong team awaits you

Your closest colleagues will be a team of 13 skilled professionals within a Planning Department of approximately 100 employees. The department works with a wide range of planning tasks related to wastewater, climate adaptation, and urban development. We value engagement, collaboration, and interdisciplinary cooperation, giving you ample opportunity to work across teams and professional disciplines.

Your background

Novafos expect that you have:

• A relevant education and professional background, for example as an engineer or similar

• At least 5 years of experience in wastewater and drainage engineering, preferably supplemented by certification as a sewer contractor

• Experience with site development from the private sector, utilities, or consultancy firms

• A constructive mindset, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing

• Knowledge of environmental and wastewater legislation

• Understanding of municipal planning hierarchies, including wastewater plans and local development plans

• Experience with hydraulic modelling calculations

• Possibly formal project management training

• A valid driver’s license (passenger car)

Work-life balance matters

At Novafos, we believe that a healthy balance between work and personal life is essential for well-being and job satisfaction. We respect working hours and prioritize a safe and stable working environment, allowing room for family life and personal commitments.

They offer:

• Flexible working hours and a 37-hour workweek, including lunch

• The possibility to work from home 1–2 days per week

• Attractive employment terms under the Danish Local Government (KL) collective agreement, including competitive salary and pension

• Support for professional development through courses, internal training, and education

• Modern office and parking facilities at Blokken 9 in Birkerød

• Access to a canteen, fitness center, yoga classes, massage scheme, health insurance, an active staff association, and social events such as summer parties, Christmas celebrations, and DHL relay races

Application

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and help shape the urban areas of the future with a focus on sustainable water management? Then submit your application today.

This recruitment process is managed by Capax Recruitment. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Specialist Marianne Petersen at mkp@capax.dk.

Applications are accepted only via the specified application link. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

Ambitious and skilled Global BI Specialist to drive Business Intelligence excellence

Location: Holbæk and work from home

The company Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos is a family-owned, international pharmaceutical company and a global leader in the treatment of iron deficiency anaemia. Headquartered in Holbæk, Denmark, the company employs more than 650 people worldwide with subsidiaries across Europe, the US, and Asia. Pharmacosmos is experiencing continued growth and is in the midst of an ongoing digital transformation, where data and insights play a key role in supporting decision-making across the organisation.

Your role

As a Global BI Specialist, you will play a central role in strengthening Pharmacosmos’ Business Intelligence capabilities within Finance & IT – Data & Projects. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that high-quality data and actionable insights support decision-making across the organisation.

The role is an end-to-end BI position, covering both backend data platform work and frontend reporting, combined with close collaboration with stakeholders across the business. You will work across the full BI and data stack – from Azure Data Factory pipelines and SQL-based data models to reports and dashboards consumed globally.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimising the BI and data platform, translating complex business requirements into scalable and value-creating BI solutions. Close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external BI consultants is a key part of the role, ensuring that requirements are clarified, challenged when necessary, and implemented in a robust and future-proof manner.

You will join Data & Projects, a small and highly specialised team within Finance & IT. The team consists of a Director, a Project Manager, and two Global BI Specialists and holds overall responsibility for Pharmacosmos’ BI and data platform.

The team culture is professional, collaborative, and informal, with a strong focus on knowledge sharing, sparring, and flexibility – including the option to work from home as needed.

Who you are

You are proactive, structured, and value-driven in your approach to BI and data. You thrive in roles with open-ended challenges, where requirements evolve through dialogue rather than fixed specifications. You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and focus on delivering solutions that create real business value.

You are pragmatic and operationally minded, yet able to think strategically and contribute to continuous improvements of the BI and data platform.

Your skills and experience are within

• Advanced user of Microsoft Power BI

• Proficient in SQL, capable of working in SSMS

• Familiar with ETL pipelines/integration/workflows (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, etc.)

• Analytical skills – you can dive into new problem areas and data domains and understand the architecture and data flows

• Motivated by improving business performance with insights from data

• Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics (Axapta, 365 BC or 365 F&O) data would be an advantage

• Advanced skills in Excel would be an advantage

Specific requirements

• Fluency in spoken and written English

• Danish resident

Personal competencies

You must be a naturally proactive person. You seek excellent solutions to large and small issues that you yourself continually identify – and you always work with a focus on delivering value.

You deal very well with open-ended ideas/problems. This means that you do not require a fixed written requirements specification – because none such can be provided. Rather, you thrive in a collaborative team where ideas are brainstormed informally, after which you drive the implementation of the project, report, or fix.

You are a self-driven and systematic individual with a keen eye for detail, always seeking ways to enhance the data platform and processes. Your robust interpersonal skills enable you to collaborate effectively with others, having natural authority while maintaining an easy-going demeanor.

With excellent analytical skills and an open-minded approach to communication, combined with your natural ability to connect with others, you adeptly tackle complex challenges.

You are known for your strong sense of accountability, consistently delivering on agreements in a timely manner. You align to agreed priorities and execute swiftly.

You are a pragmatic and operationally minded thinker, always seeking practical solutions to challenges.

Additional Information

Place of work is Pharmacosmos HQ in Holbæk. Flexible work from home opportunities can be arranged with the direct manager. Limited travel may be required (5–10 days per year). This position offers strong opportunities for professional development as Pharmacosmos continues its digital transformation and global expansion.

Contact and Application

Applications and interviews are handled on an ongoing basis. Early application is recommended.

This recruitment process is handled by Capax Recruitment. Please feel free to contact Benedikte Berg Heinild at bhe@capax.dk with questions about the position. Applications can be submitted in both Danish and English.

Do you want to drive strategic, cross-functional projects and play a key role in strengthening digitalisation in a growing international pharmaceutical company?

Pharmacosmos are looking for a Project Manager to join the Data & Projects team in Holbæk. In this role, you will play a central part in driving and coordinating strategic projects across the organisation, with a particular focus on digitalization, implementation of IT systems and optimization of business processes.

You will become part of Data & Projects, a small team within Finance & IT that works closely with stakeholders across the organisation to support our continued development. The team plays an important role in ensuring a structured approach to project execution and enabling effective use of data across the business.

As Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning, structuring and delivering projects from early idea and analysis through to implementation and completion.

The projects vary in size and complexity but are typically related to digitalisation, implementation of new systems and optimisation of existing processes. A key focus area in the coming period will be to project manage the implementation of Veeva, alongside other strategic initiatives.

You are proactive, solution-oriented and take responsibility for driving projects forward, while actively engaging with project teams and ensuring momentum and quality in delivery.

Phamacosmos offers

At Pharmacosmos, you will become part of a growing organisation where they work every day to improve treatment options for patients worldwide.

You will take on a role with a high degree of responsibility and a broad interface across the organisation, working on projects that have significant impact on Pharmacosmos’ continued development.

Pharmacosmos offers you:

A central role in strategic and cross-functional projects

Your application and CV (in English) should be submitted as soon as possible, using the link below. This recruitment is supported by Capax Recruitment. Please contact Vjollca Muaremi at vmu@capaxrecruitment.com for any questions about the recruitment.

About Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on our foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, we develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA.

Company presentation

Qtechnology is a leading innovator in smart camera technology, specializing in cutting-edge solutions for industrial vision and research and development (R&D). Established in 2007 as a subsidiary of Newtec Group, Qtechnology was originally focusing on embedded vision systems for optical sorting and grading. Qtechnology is now set to launch a range of hyperspectral cameras, which, when integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning, promises transformative opportunities across diverse applications.

As the company aims to scale and establish itself as a global leader, Qtechnology seeks talented individuals to join its journey and contribute to its ambitious growth and success.

Under the leadership of CEO Lars R. Fenger, Qtechnology emphasizes building dynamic core teams and fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives.

Description of the department

Qtechnology are a team of highly passionate people working to change the vision industry. The team, currently contains twelve employees, and operates within a larger corporate structure under Newtec Group, providing the stability and resources of a well-established organization while maintaining the innovative spirit of a startup.

The department is characterized by a fun and informal atmosphere, underpinned by a flat organizational structure. This environment fosters creativity and encourages open dialogue, allowing team members to contribute actively to the company’s vision and success.

The team consists of highly passionate professionals with a strong technical background, who are committed to advancing the field of industrial vision technology. As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work alongside competent colleagues, contribute to significant technological advancements, and shape the role to match both your personal and professional growth aspirations.

Introduction to the position

As the Manufacturing Manager at QTechnology you will play an integral part in establishing their test systems and define the quality assurance of their internal processes in relation to their production.

Today, all production of their cameras happens in-house. However, Qtechnology are experiencing an increase in the demand of their products. Therefore, they are now aiming to outsource their production to either Poland or Asia, which means that there needs to be created and defined internal end-of-line test systems and quality loops that can be placed at their new contract manufacturer.

In this role you will therefore have the responsibility of defining and developing these test systems, document all processes and systems while ensuring that these operate optimally. You will also play a part in coordinating the outsourcing with the contract manufacturer.

Once the production have been outsourced you will be responsible for the production planning, S&OP, and the overall internal quality assurance.

The position offers you the freedom and autonomy to define and execute your tasks, while also providing opportunities for professional development and growth.You will interact closely with a diverse and international team as well as a number of external stakeholders.

Requirements

It is imperative that you have:

• Strong experience with quality assurance, possibly from an NPI role.

• Knowledge of working with a contract manufacturer.

• Experience in describing and defining test system

• Experience with documentation of internal processes

Application and Information

For more information, please contact Mia Sonne, Capax Recruitment, via email at mso@capaxrecruitment.com.

We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, by clicking the “Apply now” button.

Become a key link in Pharmacosmos’ global value chain

Do you thrive in a dynamic and international Supply Chain where structure, coordination, and continuous improvement are essential? Are you motivated by playing a central role in ensuring efficient and compliant supply chain processes? If so, you might be the new Supply Chain Specialist to join their headquarters at Pharmacosmos in Holbæk. Reporting to Senior Product Supply Manager you will be part of a global Supply Chain team.

Here, you will take responsibility for day-to-day execution while also helping to build and improve processes and systems in line with their growth journey.

About Pharmacosmos and the department

Pharmacosmos is a global pharmaceutical company in significant growth, delivering more than 20 percent annual growth in recent years. Headquartered in Holbæk, they also have subsidiaries in the US, Germany, the UK, and China. More than 650 colleagues worldwide work together to develop innovative treatments within iron deficiency and related diseases.

As a Supply Chain Specialist at Pharmacosmos, you will become part of a strong and collaborative team that works closely with contract manufacturers, QA, production, customer service, and sales across both Denmark and international markets.

The Supply Chain department manages planning, sourcing, and material flows for both raw materials and finished goods, and is characterized by a dynamic and supportive culture with flat structures and broad responsibilities, giving you the chance to make a visible impact. Collaboration across functions is at the core of how they work, and you will contribute not only to daily operations but also to ongoing improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.

The role

As Supply Chain Specialist, you will play a central role in the daily execution of supply chain activities within a GMP-regulated environment. You will act as a key link across the value chain, working closely with QA, production, customer service, sales, international contract manufacturers, and affiliates.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking operational responsibility for selected CMO partners in Europe and the US, including coordination, troubleshooting, and follow-up through regular meetings

• Handling order flow, purchasing, and supplier interactions while ensuring compliance with GMP standards

• Supporting affiliates with planning, reconciliations, and alignment of local needs

• Acting as a link between internal and external stakeholders to secure alignment and efficient collaboration

• Maintaining accurate and up-to-date master data in ERP, including BOMs and recipes

• Contributing to process improvements, ERP implementation, and cross-functional projects

A crucial part of the role is contributing to Pharmacosmos’ digital transformation. You will work with data-driven decision-making, support the implementation of a new ERP system, and help automate processes to create a more scalable and future-ready supply chain. With your analytical mindset and strong Excel skills, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact.

Your profile

Pharmacosmos is looking for a candidate who enjoys hands-on supply chain work and at the same time wants to contribute to improvements and development. You bring a strong operational mindset, solid ERP understanding, and thrive in a structured yet fast-paced environment. You understand the importance of compliance and documentation and have a proactive and service-minded approach to problem-solving.

To succeed in the role, you should bring:

• Minimum three years of experience in supply chain or production planning, preferably within a GMP-regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science, or food

• Solid experience with ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar)

• Good understanding of the interfaces between production, QA, and supply chain

• Strong Excel skills and a data-driven approach

• Fluency in Danish, both written and spoken, and professional English communication skills

• Relevant education within supply chain or a related field is considered an advantage

It will be an advantage if you have experience with process optimization or system implementation.

Pharmacosmos offers

At Pharmacosmos, you will step into a central role in a growing company where you can develop both operationally and professionally. You will experience broad responsibility in a flat organization, close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international partners, and a culture built on trust, ownership, and professionalism.

Pharmacosmos offers a competitive salary and benefits package, with your daily base at their production site in Holbæk.

Application

Are you ready to take part in Pharmacosmos’ digital transformation and help further develop their infrastructure? Then send your application today.

jobs.occupation: Section Manager for Wastewater Treatment Plants
jobs.description:
At Novafos, we are everyday heroes in water management—delivering clean drinking water to taps, managing rainwater in urban areas, and returning treated wastewater to the natural environment. We are approximately 400 dedicated employees who work every day to create solutions where society and the environment can thrive side by side.

Novafos are now seeking a Section Manager for Project 1 (Wastewater Treatment Plants) who will act as the driving force behind a highly skilled project team and ensure sustainable solutions across our facilities.

A role with responsibility, professionalism, and development

As Section Manager for Project 1, you will be responsible for a specialized team of 11 project managers working with the operation, maintenance, and renewal of Novafos’ existing wastewater treatment plants. Part of the team also contributes to the preparation of future water resource centers, which will gradually replace the current facilities—an important step in realizing Novafos’ long-term strategy.

You will have overall responsibility for the team’s project portfolio, ensuring progress, effective resource prioritization, and robust processes so that projects are successfully transitioned into operations. At the same time, you will serve as a key sparring partner, supporting both the professional and personal development of your team members.

You will be part of the management group, contributing to well-being, culture, and strategic development across the organization. In close collaboration with fellow managers, you will also help prepare and report on investment agreements to our nine owner municipalities.

Your leadership style

They are looking for a leader who delivers results through others—someone who can unite a team around shared goals and strike a balance between clear direction and autonomy.

As a leader, we expect you to:

• Be credible, clear, and inclusive

• Communicate effectively and provide constructive feedback

• Work in a goal-oriented and structured manner while remaining open to new ways of collaboration

Your responsibilities

As Section Manager, you will be the driving force behind the team’s success. Your tasks will include:

• Leading and developing your team and strengthening cross-functional collaboration

• Translate security policies into technical security measures and oversee their implementation.

• Contribute to the development of security control reports, working towards ISO 27001 certification.

Requirements

• 3-4 years of experience in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) or IT security policy implementation.

• Strong understanding and interest in working with ISO 27001, NIST, and regulatory frameworks (NIS2, FDA, European pharmaceutical regulations).

• Experience in a regulated industry (e.g., pharmaceutical, finance, healthcare, or similar) is highly preferred.

**The position is located at the Cementir Holding Research and Quality Centre, located in Aalborg. Since 2004, Aalborg Portland has been part of the Cementir Group.
